models.name: Cardiac conduction system
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A see-through heart with the electrical conduction pathway picked out and labelled, running from the SA and AV nodes through the bundle of His and both bundle branches to the moderator band and the Purkinje fibres.
structures: Anterior papillary muscle of right ventricle

models.name: Heart, valves and auscultation sites
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A see-through heart with the trachea and bronchi, its valves visible inside, and five markers for the stethoscope points: the second right, second left, third left and fourth left intercostal spaces and the apex. The markers are labelled in Dutch.
structures: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve

models.name: Cardiac anatomy: coronary arteries of the heart
models.author: HannahNewey
models.summary: A finely sculpted heart focused on its blood supply. Fourteen annotations follow the left and right coronary arteries and their branches, including the anterior interventricular, circumflex, marginal, SA nodal and posterior interventricular arteries.

models.name: Cardiac anatomy: external view of the heart
models.author: HannahNewey
models.summary: A detailed outside view of the heart with 20 labels. They cover the chambers and auricles, the aorta, the pulmonary trunk and veins, the venae cavae, the ligamentum arteriosum, both coronary arteries, and the coronary sinus with its cardiac veins.

models.name: Plastinated heart: classic valve view
models.author: VisibleHeartLabs
models.summary: An unlabelled 3D scan of a real preserved donor heart, cut across its base so all four valves are seen together from above, with the removed atria placed beside it.
structures: Posterior leaflet of left atrioventricular valve

models.name: Mesenteric artery wall
models.author: GLS
models.summary: A small mesenteric artery wall rebuilt from confocal microscopy. The endothelium, elastic laminae, elastin fibres, sympathetic nerve fibres and surrounding perivascular fat are each colour-coded and labelled.

models.name: Bicuspid aortic valve
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A heart whose aortic valve has two leaflets instead of three, the most common congenital valve defect, with 18 labels on the chambers, great vessels and valves. The label on the abnormal valve reads 'Bicuspid pulmonary valve', although the defect is in the aortic valve.

models.name: Ventricular septal defect
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A heart with its lungs and great vessels showing two holes in the wall between the ventricles: a perimembranous one close to the valves and a muscular one lower down. There are 17 labels.
structures: Septal leaflet of right atrioventricular valve

models.name: Anatomy of the skin
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: Schematic block of hair-bearing skin made for a Groningen dermatology course, with the epidermis, dermis and subcutaneous fat stacked in layers and follicles, sweat glands and vessels running through them.

models.name: Long Bone
models.author: iqcenter
models.summary: Schematic wedge of a long-bone shaft that exposes ringed osteons in the compact cortex, a trabecular inner zone and marrow, with colour-coded vessels and nerve running through the canals.

models.name: Visible Interactive Human - Exploding skull
models.author: witmerlab
models.summary: Animated skull built from a CT scan that gradually pulls apart into its separate cranial and facial bones, like a classic exploded-skull preparation.

models.name: Ligaments of the Female Pelvis
models.author: tilt
models.summary: University of Dundee teaching model of a female pelvis with its main ligaments, including the sacrospinous, sacrotuberous, iliolumbar and sacro-iliac ligaments, checked for accuracy by anatomists.

models.name: Anatomy of the airways
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A CT-based sculpt of the trachea and bronchial tree branching inside translucent lungs, built by a university medical centre for a course on thoracic imaging.

models.name: Epithelium of the Trachea
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-by-cell model of the tracheal lining, with ciliated pseudostratified columnar cells and goblet cells all sitting on an unusually thick basal lamina.

models.name: Epithelium of the Duodenum
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of a duodenal villus covered by simple columnar absorptive cells with goblet cells scattered among them.

models.name: Epithelium of the Colon
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of colonic mucosa, with straight crypts lined by simple columnar cells and many goblet cells.

models.name: Abdomen Anatomy
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A university teaching model of the abdominal organs and great vessels, with an animation that turns the overlying organs transparent to reveal the pancreas.

models.name: Epithelium of the Bladder
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A cell-level model of the urothelium, the layered transitional lining of the bladder in which only the lowest cells touch the basal lamina.

models.name: Urinary tract
models.author: eLearningUMCG
models.summary: A CT-based model of the kidneys, ureters and bladder shown in place within the skeleton, made by a university medical centre for an imaging course.

models.name: Polycystic kidney
models.author: siebenmedicalart
models.summary: A sculpted kidney swollen and misshapen by many cysts of different sizes, illustrating polycystic kidney disease.

models.name: Anatomy of the Inner Ear
models.author: tilt
models.summary: A University of Dundee model of the middle and inner ear built largely from segmented MRI data, with 13 labels on the eardrum, malleus, incus and stapes, the three semicircular canals, the cochlea, and the facial and vestibulocochlear nerves with the chorda tympani and greater petrosal branches.
